+# json_batch1: bounded authored JSON receipts
+
+Baseline supplied by coordinator: `b9ce5e523d56076c1ebf7ea32a2499da43bebfc9`; accepted root ledger **1,619 rows**. Exactly ten literal selected UTF-8 JSON originals total **10,054 bytes**. The selection is copied unchanged as APPROVED_INPUTS.tsv.
+
+**Disposition: ten complete exact copies; zero privacy variants, aliases, duplicate bodies or deferred files.** All measured original SHA/size values equal selection catalog pins. Root source/destination SHA lookup and within-batch lookup found no duplicates. Each original passed literal containment and no-reparse checks before reading. No linked file or URI was opened.
+
+## What these records preserve
+
+These are authored historical receipts, not ten new discoveries. One B-owned boundary-check summary records counts, checksums, claimed PASS and its limited kind2/4 windows/kind3 prefix coverage. Nine E/T020 readback records preserve synthetic/static review counts, fixture/runner/source fingerprints, excluded or not-run cases, historical states and provenance. Their subjects are training-count gates, signed dual scores, leader cache, cache lifecycle, bucket merge, RNG-context negative inference, drain/restore capacity, view-flag chains and post-refill dispatch.
+
+Training06H/07H/08H receipts contain aggregate audit metadata and short conditional cleanup/caching summaries. They do not reproduce the separately excluded E T01109H/10H/11H erase bodies or13H artifacts. Opaque source/file hashes and linked case/runner/acceptance filenames are identifiers; their targets were not fetched, interpreted as code, reconstructed or executed. No full game asset/script or substantive known held native/helper payload was found in the selected ten bodies.
+
+Recorded PASS, SYNTHETIC_EXECUTED, native-anchor counts, historical Python exit codes, independent readback claims, formal checkpoints and READY totals remain author-reported historical values. They were not rerun or independently certified here. Golden/strict/dynamic zeros and VERIFY/NOT READY/OPEN states remain intact. The post-refill receipt's earlier malformed expected SHA and claimed subsequent correction are history, not a new correction or successful rerun by this intake. No field width/type, class identity, function boundary, behavior, call/write relation or runtime claim is promoted.
+
+## Useful existing lookup anchors
+
+EXISTING_LOOKUP_ANCHORS.tsv provides two **navigation-only** connections via recorded primary-report hashes and existing dictionary source metadata:
+
+- [Training_GetEffectiveUpCount,0x595320](../../../reference/symbols/00595320.md): the06H receipt records the same primary SHA as the already accepted training-count source and existing dictionary entry.
+- [TreeHeader_InitSentinel,0x49ED90](../../../reference/symbols/0049ED90.md): the08H lifecycle receipt's primary SHA/study ID resolves to the already accepted source cited by this existing entry.
+
+The JSON receipts do not themselves contain those VAs or prove the function semantics. The linked-primary identity was matched from root-ledger metadata only; no primary original, case set, runner, acceptance body or helper tail was opened. Use the existing entry/current REF and original cited report limits for semantic questions. No new dictionary adoption follows from a receipt hash.
+
+## Byte and line integrity
+
+All ten JSON bodies were reviewed fully in untruncated physical LF ranges recorded in REVIEW_IDENTITY.tsv. JSON parsing was syntax validation only; saved bytes were never reserialized. The574-byte boundary check ends without a final LF (13 content lines); all other selected receipts retain their original terminal LF. Original byte counts, line endings, whitespace, key order and text are preserved exactly. No personal home path or other privacy token requiring a change was observed. TRANSFORM_RECEIPTS covers full [0,bytes) identity spans; PRIVACY_SPANS and DEFERRED are intentionally header-only.
+
+REPORT_LEDGER uses the exact root nine-column schema. REVIEW_IDENTITY records role, selected researchID/owner/tasks, catalog/current identities, full LF bounds, no-reparse/containment/JSON results and limitations. INPUT_RECEIPTS pins selection, baseline ledger and ten originals (12 snapshots). OUTPUT_MANIFEST lists every output file except itself; VERIFICATION records final comparisons.
+
+Only this task folder was written. No root/shared/canonical/code/Git or original mutation occurred. The already-authorized built-in local fallback followed prior Local compactHTTP429; no Remote/network was used. All four agent slots were occupied during intake, so no additional reviewer was spawned; full physical ranges and receipts are available for coordinator review. This is recovery integrity, not native/runtime/Golden/READY verification. Future shared-metadata edits are separate from these preparation-point input receipts.
